svg.title: Nabla Lab symbol — white
svg.desc: The original paired inverted and upright triangle outlines on a transparent background.
svg.metadata: Original Nabla Laboratory artwork supplied by Nabla Lab. Source: nabla-lab-logo-2.pdf and nabla-lab-symbol.svg. This colour variant preserves the original vector outlines. Copyright and reuse rights remain with the original rights holder; permission is required to reuse the Nabla identity.
